scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm --prefix functions run build && vite build --configLoader runner
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/firebase.mjs deploy --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes,functions,hosting --project rpg-rewards-paul --non-interactive && node scripts/configure-player-endpoint.cjs
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/emulators.mjs
scripts.verify:emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/emulators.mjs verify
